Good to know

Before you go

Documents

Passport required; EU national ID cards are not accepted. EU citizens also need a UK ETA (£20), usually approved within a day; allow 3 working days. GOV.UK

Weather and time

Mid-November in Cambridge: 5–11 °C, showers possible, sunset about 16:00. UK time is one hour behind Belgium.

Power and payment

UK sockets are type G (230 V), so bring an adapter. Cards and contactless payment are accepted almost everywhere.

Questions
